title: Native library loaded by name (java)
description: The code loads a native library through System.loadLibrary. The name is resolved by the platform loader, which searches the working directory and the library path before trusted locations, so a planted file is loaded instead of the packaged one.
remediation: Load a packaged library by absolute path, or verify its signature before loading, for example an absolute path with a verified hash.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the load without resolving the name.
